description: Check a Base transaction BEFORE signing it. Send an UNSIGNED transaction and get three independent lenses: a simulation against current state (does it revert?), the decoded intent (is this an unlimited approval that outlives the trade?), and the counterparty's liquidity-removal history from true402's archive. Takes NO private key and NO signature, so the service cannot broadcast or front-run the transaction it inspects. Never returns 'safe': a clean result means these checks found nothing, and every response states its limits. PAID x402 service (USDC on Base) — needs a funded wallet on the MCP server.

data.description: Calldata hex (0x…); omit for a plain native transfer

from.description: Sender address. Asserted, never proven — no signature is taken.

value.description: Native value in wei as a decimal string; default 0
